sloka: अथोवाच महात्मानमिक्ष्वाकूणां महारथः ।रामो मतिमतां श्रेष्ठः क्षत्रधर्ममनुस्मरन् ।। ७.७६.३४ ॥
transliteration: athovāca mahātmānamikṣvākūṇāṁ mahārathaḥ ।rāmo matimatāṁ śreṣṭhaḥ kṣatradharmamanusmaran ।। 7.76.34 ॥

translations.english: Then, Rama, the great warrior of the Ikshvakus and the best among the intelligent, spoke to the great-souled one, remembering the duties of a Kshatriya.
